sources.name: Kiranico MH4U

stateSuffixes.-post-break: Part after it has been broken.

notes: Crimson Fatalis and White Fatalis have no damage/hitzone table on Kiranico or in the MH4U database. They are included with empty parts; no Fatalis values were copied or assumed.

Apex Rajang, Apex Tidal Najarala, Apex Deviljho, Apex Gravios, Apex Tigrex, Apex Diablos, Apex Seregios, and Apex Zinogre are kept as separate entries because the source provides separate rows for them.
Tigerstripe Zamtrios' source 'Enraged' table is an exact duplicate of Zamtrios' Ice Shield table and is absent from Kiranico's Tigerstripe Zamtrios page, so it was not included.
No MH3U data was used. All hitzone values come from MH4U sources.
